transcript: I believe in freedom, and I believe that the moral commonwealth gives people the greatest amount of personal freedom. But I also believe in the benefits of technology, so that's why I rank futurist and modern green utopias second and third, and AI as well. And the nightmare dystopian scenario for me is living in a theocracy, or just above that, living in a society which has no technological capacity at all.
